enabled.label: Enable OMDb
enabled.description: Master on/off for OMDb rating enrichment. Optional; default off.

api_key.label: OMDb API Key
api_key.description: Your OMDb API key. The free tier allows 1,000 requests/day.
api_key.link_text: Get a free OMDb API key

use_ssl_verification.label: Verify SSL
use_ssl_verification.description: Verify the TLS certificate presented by OMDb. Keep this ON. Turning it off lets any intercepting hop read and tamper with the traffic — including the API key that OMDb sends in the URL query string, which could be stolen. Use off only when debugging behind a proxy you control.

cache_ttl_seconds.label: Cache TTL (seconds)
cache_ttl_seconds.description: How long to cache OMDb responses; 0 disables the cache. Optional; default 86400 (24 hours).
